items.title: Pushforward of an injective module is acyclic for the global section functors of the target
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: For a morphism of ringed spaces f: X to Y and an injective O_X-module I, the lemma shows that the Cech cohomology of the pushforward vanishes in positive degrees for every open covering of Y, that its cohomology vanishes on every open of Y, and hence that the pushforward is right acyclic for the global section functors of Y (statement lines 1778-1794). The proof is a termwise identification: the Cech complex of the pushforward with respect to a covering of Y equals the Cech complex of I with respect to the inverse image covering of X, because the value of the pushforward on an intersection is the value of I on the inverse image of that intersection (proof lines 1797-1809). The vanishing for I is a previous lemma, and the passage from Cech vanishing to cohomological vanishing is the vanishing criterion already established (proof lines 1810-1812). The claim is H2: one termwise computation plus two cited inputs, with the identification of the complexes written out in full.
